resources.string: যেকোনো লেখা বাংলায় বুঝুন ও শুনুন\nUnderstand and listen to any text in Bengali

How to use: 1) Start the magnifier. 2) Open any app. 3) Drag the green magnifier and drop it on the text (a green frame shows what will be read). 4) Press the Speaker button to listen.

Tip: a single tap on the magnifier lets you draw your own box instead. Dropping the magnifier at the far left or right edge only parks it.

When Android asks what to share, choose "Entire screen" (or "Start now").
Bangla Lens needs permission to \"Display over other apps\" so the magnifier can float above Facebook, WhatsApp and other apps. Nothing is captured until you tap the magnifier and select text.
Magnifier is on. Open any app and drag the green magnifier onto text.
Screen capture permission was not given.
No text yet. Start the magnifier and select some text.
Bangla Lens magnifier. Tap, then drag over text.
